system.description:
When trouble rears its head, you know how to get out of its way. Unhesitating reactions let you evade blows and shots — diving for cover as someone fires, or twisting away from a sword.

You can use Dodge against any attack you are aware of, expending it as a retest when defending against an attack you can see or sense coming.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
